verdict.rationale: Runway Ads is the one documented capability that runs as a self-driving loop: it generates ads, publishes them to Meta, Google and TikTok, then builds the next round from performance. That counts as product-owned autonomous automation, but it is limited to the ads use case. Workflows and Recipes are multi-step pipelines invoked on demand as endpoints, not background automations, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: general user-configurable automations, recurring schedules or event triggers, documented background execution and monitoring controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Runway Ads automatically generates on-brand video and image ads, publishes them to Meta, Google and TikTok, then builds the next round around what earned spend.
